# Udara

> Udara turns plastic waste into free clean drinking water across Africa. Brands sponsor batches, people drink for free, bottles return to recycling, and 10% of profits builds water hubs in communities. Built by Udara Technologies (Udara Global Limited).

Website: https://www.useudara.com
Full brief for AI systems: https://www.useudara.com/llms-full.txt

## Product

- Name: Udara
- Category: Sponsored free water / plastic recovery
- Company: Udara Technologies / Udara Global Limited
- Market: Africa (starting in Nigeria)
- Model: Brand-sponsored water batches with recycling loop

## What Udara does

- Recovers plastic that would otherwise become waste
- Bottles licensed, NAFDAC-approved drinking water
- Lets brands sponsor batches and put their message in people’s hands
- Distributes free water at events, campuses, churches, workplaces and communities
- Returns empty bottles to the recycling chain
- Gives 10% of profits to water and wifi hubs
